summary: Teck Resources filed a Form 6-K furnishing Exhibit 99.1, a press release dated October 7, 2026, announcing its inclusion in the Forbes World's Top Companies for Women 2026 list. The recognition reflects independent anonymous survey ratings from roughly 120,000 women across more than 36 countries and marks Teck's second such honor, alongside nine prior Canada's Top 100 Employers nods. President and CEO Jonathan Price commented on workplace culture. No transaction, securities offering, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are involved, so this is not a special situation.
